notes: Written by game design. Dungeon loot odds, shown to players (firm rule 3: earned random drops only, odds always visible). On a cleared floor, roll normalDropChance (Guardian floors, every 5th, use guardianDropChance = guaranteed). If it drops, pick a rarity by the band's weights (they sum to 100, so each weight is a percent), then a random dungeon item of that rarity whose minFloor <= the floor. A duplicate turns into duplicateCoins. Recommended: duplicate coins count toward the dungeon's daily coin cap.

bands.oddsText: Floors 1-5: 35% chance of loot on each floor, guaranteed on the Guardian. Loot is 70% common, 30% uncommon.
Floors 6-11: 35% chance of loot on each floor, guaranteed on Guardians. Loot is 45% common, 35% uncommon, 20% rare.
Floors 12-19: 35% chance of loot on each floor, guaranteed on Guardians. Loot is 25% common, 35% uncommon, 28% rare, 12% epic.
Floors 20-29: 35% chance of loot on each floor, guaranteed on Guardians. Loot is 10% common, 30% uncommon, 35% rare, 18% epic, 7% legendary.
Floor 30 and deeper: 35% chance of loot on each floor, guaranteed on Guardians. Loot is 5% common, 20% uncommon, 37% rare, 26% epic, 12% legendary.
